name: The air base, runway 09/27
summary: The test field's military runway, north of the middle: 9,000 ft like Kunsan's. Landed on westward (27) from its eastern threshold; both ends take a 10 NM final.

sources.length_m: Kunsan AB (RKJK), the fighter base's pattern: runway 18/36, 9,000 ft (2,743 m) by 150 ft. FAA Chart Supplement, Kunsan AB.
sources.protection: FAA AC 150/5300-13B's airliner table as the civil runways', standing in for UFC 3-260-01's clear zone; the ground's 34:1 funnel is the same on every runway end.
sources.place: North of the middle at z -14 km (lane/testfield step 0), east-west so both 10 NM finals end at x +-19.9 km.
